newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Henkel to use debt for Loctite.
newsitem.headline: German Henkel to use debt for Loctite.

text.p: German consumer products group Henkel KGaA said on Monday it would use debt to finance its takeover bid for the remaining shares it does not own in the U.S. adhesives group Loctite.

A spokesman for Henkel said there would be no rights issue to cover the costs of the bid for Loctite, of which Henkel already owns 35 percent. The takeover bid is estimated to be worth around 1.7 billion marks.
Earlier, the group said it had offered to pay about $56 per share.
The rating agency Standard & Poor's said later on Monday it had placed its AA minus senior unsecured and A1 plus commercial paper ratings of Henkel on CreditWatch with negative implications.
